title: ZOE
content:
Caring for her father for years, Zoe can't stop taking responsibility for everyone and risks losing her son.
[
• Trailer](https://vimeo.com/945965101/b1a03b69b4?share=copy)

details.text_middle: What does it mean to take responsibility for several people? Working on ‘Zoe’, we tried to relate to a mother's reality, taking the perspective of a teenage son. During the research and script development with author Nicola Jakobi, we spoke to women who were 55 to 60 years old and often had to take care of their children and parents at the same time. It became more and more important for us to address Zoe's inner urgency without being afraid of pathetic images and to try to visualise the pressure she faces. I was particularly interested in Zoe's driven mindset, a restless feeling of being forced to take responsibility for almost everyone, that became a linking element in the editing.
